notes:
Topline:
- Mid-market SaaS (B2B support automation). Evaluating Hosted API first, with clear path to Dedicated if latency/cost justify it.
- Primary workload: multi-turn chat agents + tool calling to CRM + KB search fallback. Streaming & low token-latency critical.
- Customer quote: 'Need streaming responses + tool calls that feel instant to users. Token-level latency matters more than raw throughput.'
Evaluation nuance:
- POC requested: 2-week Hosted API POC to validate 95th pct token latency and streaming UX. If pass, move to pricing for Dedicated commit.
Security focus:
- Must support SSO/SAML for admin console; SOC2 reported required; audit logs + retention policy + ability to redact PII from logs.
- Data residency: prefer NA region; dedicated VPC for Dedicated plan.
POC success criteria:
- 95th pct latency (token generation) <= 300ms for typical 1:1 chat flows (seq len ~256).
- Streaming latency perceived < 500ms for initial token.
- Reliable tool-calling (webhook auth) with retries and structured response support.
- Logs show redaction or tokenization of PII fields (email, ssn) before retention.
Stakeholders:
- CTO (Aniya Rao) - final sign-off on infra & security.
- Product Lead (Tom Blevins) - cares about UX/latency.
- Head of Ops (Lina Cho) - pricing & run-rate.
Operational notes:
- Concern: hosted logs retention - wants 30 day default, ability to purge on demand.
- Wants KMS integration for encryption-at-rest for Dedicated.
- Asked about model fallback: prefer automatic routing to cheaper variants w/ fallback to higher-cap when quality suffers.

poc_details:
POC scope (2 weeks hosted):
- Baseline: integrate Hosted API with existing chat frontend, enable streaming + tool-calling to CRM/webhooks.
- Metrics to capture: per-token latency (p50/p95), end-to-end time to first token, tool call round-trip, error rate.
- Dataset: 500 representative conversation flows incl. edge cases + tool invocation.
- Deliverables: metrics dashboard, logs with PII-redaction verification, short report and exec demo.
-Acceptance: meet latency SLOs + security sign-off on log redaction and retention policy.
pricing_notes:
AgentLoop price-sensitivity: wants predictable unit cost at scale. Mentioned target ARR range $50k-$150k.
- Concerned about minimums for Dedicated (ask: can Dedicated start at small commit?).
- Wants examples: 12-mo commit with monthly usage credits, bursting option, clear overage behavior.
security_review_summary:
Security highlights from questionnaire exchange:
- SSO/SAML: requires IdP metadata + SP-initiated SAML flow; PB: AgentLoop will bring IdP (Okta).
- SOC2: requested copy of SOC2 Type II report (provided redacted).
- Audit/logging: needs audit log retention policy default 30 days, ability to purge on-demand; logs must support field-level redaction.
- PII redaction: must redact or hash email/phone/SSNs from request logs; want proof-of-concept purge and redaction flow during POC.
- KMS: Dedicated must support customer-managed keys (CMK) for at-rest encryption.
- Data residency: hosted NA region OK for now; Dedicated must allow VPC placement in their AWS account.
